# Filter rows where Season is between 2007 and 2010 (inclusive)
filtered_df = df[(df['Season'] >= 2007) & (df['Season'] <= 2010)]

# Replace '—' in Points column with NaN for proper numeric conversion
filtered_df['Points'] = pd.to_numeric(filtered_df['Points'].replace('—', pd.NA), errors='coerce')

# Find the minimum points value among the filtered rows
min_points = filtered_df['Points'].min()

# Assign the result to answer
answer = min_points
